title: Sharp estimates for the Laplacian torsional rigidity with negative Robin boundary conditions
summary: Motivated by pioneering works of Bandle and Wagner, given a bounded Lipschitz domain $Ω\subset \mathbb R^d$ with $d\ge3$, we consider the Robin-Laplacian torsional rigidity $τ_α(Ω)$ with negative boundary parameter $α$ and we show that sharp inequalities for $τ_α(Ω)$ hold if $|α|$ is small enough. In particular, we prove that, if $|α|$ is smaller than the first non-trivial Steklov-Laplacian eigenvalue, then the ball maximises $τ_α(Ω)$ among all convex domains under perimeter or volume constraints.This solves an open problem raised by Bandle and Wagner.
